newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP Yamasaki sees Nikkei topping 21,000 soon--Jiji.
newsitem.headline: LDP Yamasaki sees Nikkei topping 21,000 soon--Jiji.

text.p: The Liberal Democratic Party's top policymaker Taku Yamasaki said on Monday the Nikkei stock average will likely rise above 21,000 by the end of this summer, Jiji news agency reported.

Yamasaki, who chairs the ruling party's Policy Research Council, told a meeting of corporate managers in Tokyo that the government's monthly economic report last week signaled that Japan's economy is entering a full-scale recovery, Jiji said.
Japanese stock prices will rise on the back of such favourable economic fundamentals, Jiji quoted Yamasaki as saying.
An LDP official at the secretariat for the council chairman said she was unable to immediately confirm the report.
The Nikkei stock average of 225 issues on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's first section has been hovering at around 20,000 yen in recent sessions.
